nights.title: The Afghan Whigs
nights.name: The Afghan Whigs
nights.extract: The Afghan Whigs are an American rock band from Cincinnati, Ohio. They were active from 1986 to 2001, reformed briefly in 2006 and again from 2011 to present.

en.who: The Afghan Whigs are an American rock band from Cincinnati, Ohio. They were active from 1986 to 2001 and reformed in 2006 and again from 2011.

de.who: The Afghan Whigs sind eine amerikanische Rockband aus Cincinnati, Ohio. Sie waren von 1986 bis 2001 aktiv und formierten sich 2006 kurz sowie ab 2011 erneut.
facts: Die Band stammt aus Cincinnati, Ohio.

tr.who: The Afghan Whigs, Ohio'nun Cincinnati kentinden bir Amerikan rock grubudur. 1986 ile 2001 arasında aktifti; 2006'da kısa süreliğine ve 2011'den itibaren yeniden birlikte.
